flows.title: Call someone from Messenger
steps: A voice-enabled Textmagic virtual number has to be on the account before Messenger can place or take a call.
Open the relevant chat, or start a new one.
Click the New phone call icon to start the call.

flows.title: Send incoming calls to Messenger
steps: Find the number and click the More icon.
Select Forwarding settings from the dropdown menu.
In the Forward calls to option select Textmagic Messenger, then click Continue.
Go to the Messenger and wait for a new incoming call.
